boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Rockville Centre campus spaces documented by Molloy for gathering, studying, reflection, and student support.

cards.title: The Public Square
cards.subtitle: Student center at the Rockville Centre campus
cards.notes: Use the lounges, study rooms, computers, and printers between classes; student-life and support offices are also based here.
cards.short_summary: A central student-center stop that combines practical services with places to sit and work.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy identifies the Public Square as a student-activity hub with computers, printers, lounges, study rooms, and multiple student-support offices.
cards.access_notes: Campus building; confirm visitor access with the university before arriving.

cards.title: Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Second floor of the Public Square
cards.notes: Bring a group project or research task: the space has student computers and three study rooms with wall-mounted computers.
cards.short_summary: A social-and-academic workspace with library and IT support nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy describes the Information Commons as a social and academic gathering place with 33 student computers and three study rooms.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Study rooms can be reserved by students; availability and access rules apply.

cards.title: James E. Tobin Library
cards.subtitle: Second floor of Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Start in the Main Reading Room for research help, then use its tables, couches, study seating, scanner, and research computers.
cards.short_summary: Molloy’s principal library location for focused research and quiet group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists the James E. Tobin Library in Kellenberg Hall and documents its Main Reading Room, computers, tables, couches, and research services.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Library services and many resources are intended for the Molloy community; follow library policies.

cards.title: Rochelle Sager Media Center
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons within the James E. Tobin Library
cards.notes: Use the group-work tables or computers when you need tutoring-oriented space rather than a silent carrel.
cards.short_summary: A library learning-commons area set up for group work and tutoring sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists the Learning Commons, also called the Rochelle Sager Media Center, with computers, group-work tables, and tutoring-session use.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located within the JET Library; observe library access and conduct policies.

cards.title: Dominican Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Third floor of the James E. Tobin Library
cards.notes: Choose one of the private-study carrels when you want a defined, individual workspace for sustained reading or writing.
cards.short_summary: A named library room with individual carrels for private study.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy documents the Dominican Reading Room on the third floor of the JET Library and specifies 26 private-study carrels.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located inside the JET Library; follow current library entry and quiet-use rules.

cards.title: Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: Third floor of the James E. Tobin Library
cards.notes: Settle into a private-study carrel for reading, drafting, or test preparation, and keep calls outside the library.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet library room with individual study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists a Quiet Study Room on the JET Library’s third floor with 14 private-study carrels.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located inside the JET Library, which requires quiet phone use and adherence to library policies.

cards.title: Quinn Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Public Square Building
cards.notes: Use this named lounge as a meeting point or between-class pause, then pair it with nearby Public Square services.
cards.short_summary: A documented student lounge in the university’s central Public Square Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy’s Campus Life portal identifies the Quinn Student Lounge as one of the campus lounges in the Public Square Building.
cards.access_notes: Campus lounge; confirm building access and any event-related restrictions before visiting.

cards.title: Shakespeare Garden
cards.subtitle: Rockville Centre campus grounds
cards.notes: Take a quiet outdoor break or read at the garden; use the benches and tables while respecting the landscaped setting.
cards.short_summary: A named campus garden documented as a place for contemplation and relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists the Shakespeare Garden among campus spaces community members use for contemplation, conversation, and relaxation.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use during permitted campus access times and respect posted grounds rules.

cards.title: The Grotto
cards.subtitle: Rockville Centre campus grounds
cards.notes: Pause here for quiet reflection, then continue through the surrounding landscaped areas and outdoor seating on campus.
cards.short_summary: A named contemplative outdoor feature on Molloy’s main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy identifies the Grotto as a campus space community members enjoy for contemplation, conversation, and relaxation.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use during permitted campus access times and respect its reflective purpose.

cards.title: McGovern Plaza
cards.subtitle: Between Bogner, Fitzgerald, and Maria Regina Halls
cards.notes: Use the lounge chairs or picnic tables for an outdoor reset; keep the residential setting in mind when passing through.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped residential-campus plaza with seating, gardens, and artwork.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy describes McGovern Plaza as a campus oasis with lounge chairs, picnic tables, gardens, and artwork for contemplation and relaxation.
cards.access_notes: Located among residence halls; respect residential access controls and community quiet hours.
